en.title: Steam on the Board, Silent Trajectory
en.premise: Kai, a boy who specializes in physics calculations, keeps losing matches because he can’t handle the “fluctuations” that arise during play while chasing a perfect theory. One day he meets a lonely old man once called the “Steam Magician,” who teaches him the meaning of a single move beyond logic. Guided by ancient tactics streamed from a dawn radio, Kai searches for the ultimate trajectory that can turn the board around from a desperate situation.

zh.title: 盘上蒸汽，静寂弹道
zh.premise: 物理计算专长的少年凯，为了追求完美理论，常因无法应对比赛中的“波动”而连连失利。一天，他遇见了曾被称为“蒸汽魔术师”的孤独老人，老人教会他超越理性的一手之意。借助黎明广播里回荡的古老战术，凯在绝望中寻找能翻盘的终极弹道。
